name: vamp-vault
displayName: VAMP Vault — Credential & Certificate Isolation for AI Agents
description: Local KeePassXC & VeraCrypt MCP vault for AI agents, providing isolated credential injection and virtual USB certificate mounting.

commands.title: VAMP Vault: Set Up KeePassXC & VeraCrypt CLI

vampVault.keepassxcCliPath.description: Explicit path to keepassxc-cli. Empty means use the system installation when found, otherwise the copy downloaded into this extension's storage.

vampVault.veracryptCliPath.description: Explicit path to the VeraCrypt command line binary. Empty means use the system installation when found, otherwise the copy downloaded into this extension's storage.

vampVault.defaultKdbxPath.description: Default KeePassXC database (.kdbx) used by the vault tools. Empty means 'vault.kdbx' inside this extension's global storage.

vampVault.defaultVolumePath.description: Default VeraCrypt volume (container file or device) used by the mount tools. Empty means 'vault.hc' inside this extension's global storage.

vampVault.mountPoint.description: Default mount point for encrypted volumes. Empty means a per-user folder: a drive letter on Windows, a folder under the home directory on macOS and Linux.

vampVault.sessionCacheMinutes.description: How long a retrieved credential stays in the MCP server's memory before it must be approved and read again. 0 disables caching.

vampVault.autoDownloadCli.description: Allow the vault to download the official KeePassXC/VeraCrypt binaries for this platform when no system installation is found.

vampVault.approvalMode.description: When to ask you before a secret leaves the vault: on every read, once per entry per session, or never (off is not recommended).

scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --out vamp-vault-0.1.0.vsix
